what: A worked example: recovering a known circular structure
title: Computing Triplet Embeddings
text: build intuition good fit looks like, helps see recipe recover known circular arrangement synthetic data, since real data don’t ground truth check . Comparing raw atan2() angles (ranks) true recovered embeddings work : recovered circle’s rotation reflection arbitrary, atan2()’s wraparound point can fall anywhere relative true item ordering, linear/rank correlation two angle sequences can come strongly negative even circular structure recovered correctly. align.embeddings() avoids finding rotation reflection (, scl = TRUE, scale) best superimposes two embeddings comparing — approach package uses align embeddings across participants. RMS distance alignment close 0 good recovery; unit circle largest possible distance two points 2.
code: set.seed(0) n_items <- 16 true_angle <- sort(runif(n_items, 0, 2 * pi))  # Triplet judgments generated purely from position on the circle circ_dist <- function(i, j) {   d <- abs(true_angle[i] - true_angle[j])   pmin(d, 2 * pi - d) } n_triplets <- 4000 trip <- t(sapply(seq_len(n_triplets), function(k) {   idx <- sample(seq_len(n_items), 3)   h <- idx[1]; a <- idx[2]; b <- idx[3]   if (circ_dist(h, a) < circ_dist(h, b)) c(h, a, b) - 1L else c(h, b, a) - 1L })) split <- floor(0.8 * n_triplets)  fit <- train_embedding(   X_train = trip[1:split, ], X_test = trip[(split + 1):n_triplets, ],   d = 2L, geometry = "sphere", max_epochs = 20000L, random_state = 0L )  true_xy <- cbind(cos(true_angle), sin(true_angle)) aligned <- align.embeddings(list(true_xy, fit$embedding), scl = FALSE) recovered_aligned <- aligned[[2]]  rmse <- sqrt(mean(rowSums((true_xy - recovered_aligned)^2))) rmse

title: Computing Triplet Embeddings
text: recommendation uses one-standard-error rule: find dimensionality lowest mean hold-loss, compute one standard error mean (.e. sd_loss / sqrt(n_restarts)), flag smallest d whose mean loss falls within margin. favours parsimony — selects simplest model statistically indistinguishable best.
